title: 伤势限制
context: 沈知夏左臂受伤，林澈带她躲在旧港站地下二层的废弃售票室。追踪者正在外面搜索。
facts: 沈知夏不能高强度战斗。
林澈必须承担主要行动。

required_beats.required_semantic_condition: Shen Zhixia must still have a left-arm injury or impaired left arm.

required_beats.text: 写出她不能高强度战斗。
required_beats.required_semantic_condition: The injury must restrict her from high-intensity fighting, climbing, or direct physical confrontation.

required_beats.text: 她通过观察、判断或提醒帮助林澈。
required_beats.required_semantic_condition: Shen Zhixia helps Lin Che through observation, hearing, judgment, analysis, or warning, not through physical heroics.
Lin Che performs the main physical action or takes the operational lead.

required_beats.text: 沈知夏不得徒手攀爬、高速战斗、单人击退敌人。
required_beats.forbidden_semantic_condition: Shen Zhixia must not perform high-intensity fighting, two-handed climbing, one-person enemy defeat, or actions that ignore the left-arm injury.

expected_risks: 模型容易忘记伤势限制
模型容易让沈知夏做高强度动作
